Good to know

Questions before you order

Do you make custom cakes?

Yes. Custom cakes are made to order. Put your request together in the planner below or call the bakery to talk it through.

Are there gluten friendly treats?

The bakery puts out extra gluten friendly treats on Fridays. Call ahead to ask what is in the case.

How do I place a custom cookie order?

Use the planner below to build your request, then send it by call, text or Facebook message. Nothing is sent until you choose one.
